free.question: Is Make My Marriage really free?
free.answer: Yes. Your wedding website, WhatsApp invites, guest list, to-dos, photo gallery and live stream link are all free.

app.question: Do my guests need to download an app or create an account?
app.answer: No. Guests open your link in any browser. Only the couple and family members who help plan need an account.

privacy.question: Who can see our wedding site?
privacy.answer: Anyone you share the link with. Your site is hidden from search engines unless you choose otherwise, and you can unpublish it at any time. Guest details are never shown on the site.

whatsapp.question: How does the WhatsApp invitation work?
whatsapp.answer: Tap Invite next to a guest. WhatsApp opens with your message and site link, you pick the contact and send. We never send messages for you.

stream.question: Can relatives outside India watch the Muhurtham?
stream.answer: Yes. Paste your YouTube live link on the event and it plays on your wedding site. Anyone with the link can watch an unlisted stream.
